title: Correction to: Seasonal dietary shifts in an invasive snail Pomacea canaliculata revealed by 18S rRNA metabarcoding
content: This is a correction to: Xinni He, Zijin Qian, Ying Huang, Congcong Wang, Xuexia Li, Hong Li, Lian Chen, Seasonal dietary shifts in an invasive snail Pomacea canaliculata revealed by 18S rRNA metabarcoding, Current Zoology, 2026, 72: 321-332.
